text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened when I went to spectate a 
race. In the middle of the heated 
competition, charging at the front of the 
pack were...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
PAAAALMEEEEER!!! Let's like, totally hit a 
god-tier runaway win together at the 
finish lineee!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Kh, hell yeah! Let's go... besties for 
lifeee!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios competing with a grin, and 
Mejiro Palmer desperately keeping pace. 
The race entered the final straightaway—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Haha, missed the board completely, 
huh~...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Good work, good work! Don't make that 
face! Even though we both ended up way off 
the board~.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For now, wanna snap a selfie? I'll go grab 
my phone real quick!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, uhhh... maybe not right now. Give me 
a bit more time to get my photogenic face 
ready!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayy ayyy, what's up with that? 
Palmer's always looking totally on fleek, 
right~?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Which means right now's the perfect time, 
duhッ!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Vibes are low right now, right? Totally 
crashed, yeah? Super mega bummed☆ Crazy 
low★ Hello São Paulo! That kind of vibe, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then we gotta hype it up, no cap!? Let's 
laugh, get hyped as hell, and say hello to 
the space & stars☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We're the explosive runaway duo, hyped 
vibes are our whole thing! If we stop and 
sulk, how're we gonna break away and run?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Plus, if we snap a pic right now, it'll 
make a super emotional before-and-after 
shot when we win next time!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
—Looking forward to that victory photo! 
—You got this~! Explosive runaway duo!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, everyone! Alright, let's do a hype 
call!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Who's gonna win next time~!?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: The explosive runaway duo!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Who's center on stage~!?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: The explosive runaway duooo!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Ahaha! What an insane call and 
response. My mood really did just 
skyrocket.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, eyes forward from here on out! 
Thank you, everyoneeee!!

text_block_list.name: Palmer's Fan
text_block_list.text:
So wonderful~! Even supporting Palmer-chan 
put a huge smile on my face!

text_block_list.name: Helios' Fan
text_block_list.text:
Totally! Helios-chan's smile is so 
contagious, it makes everyone around her 
smile too! Seriously, you're the absolute 
best~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real?! Whoa, look at all those awesome 
smiles! Let's bust out a group selfie with 
everybody!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back, there were Daitaku Helios 
and Mejiro Palmer, having energized the 
entire venue.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Cheering people up with smiles, huh~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You thinking about what those fans said 
earlier?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally! Like, making everyone hyped with 
my smiles. And then I was thinking...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't it be epic if we got everyone way 
MORE hyped up!? Like, having the whole 
country see my smile and go~ boom-energy 
wild hype way-hey☆, kinda thing!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I call it—'Project Japan Hype-Up'!! 
...Whaddya think of that!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see, hyping up Japan~! ...Wait, so what 
are we actually doing?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Mmm—! Whaddya call it, like, just 
something that cranks up the vibes and 
gets everyone super hyped~~...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey hey, Trainer over there!! Got any 
hot advice!?
choice_data_list: I think you're great just the way you are!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: !!!! Right on! You're a total genius!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So it's like that, right!? Ride the trend 
waves? Don't let the big wave pass us by, 
amirite!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~, I'm getting pumped~! What should we 
do!? For starters, Trainer, you're our 
Producer!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like, the mastermind behind it all? 
Anyhoo, let's go-go! Let's do this 
together☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swept along by her overwhelming momentum, 
I ended up appointed as the Producer of 
'Project Japan Hype-Up.' Just what in the 
world was going to happen...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Which means, like... what do we actually 
do!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Got no clue, but let's roll for now, 
Partner & Producer! Let's stir up a total 
storm together!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I could even get a word in, I had 
instantly been appointed Producer... For 
now, I had no choice but to chase after 
the sprinting Daitaku Helios.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ehh—!? No changes? Why though~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her smile was already wonderful. So I 
explained that if people simply watched 
her races as she is, a circle of smiles 
would naturally spread across everyone.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ooooh... That's actually super touching!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then I'll keep going full 
throttle with max power from now on too☆ 
Thx, Trainer!
